title.narrative: Road Network Development Project I ( Bala Murghab to Leman)

description.narrative: The Project will help complete the improvements to the national ring road by constructing a 143 km section from Laman to Bala Murghab.
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Construction of part of the last missing link of the regional Ring Road Indicator: By 2022: International roughness index of the 143-km regional road surface from Bala Murghab to Leman decreases from 6.5 to at least 4.0. Achievement: N Progress/Status: Previous work suspension and contract termination hindered timely achievement of targets/results.
Contractual disputes are expected between the EA and the contractor (Qingdao Construction) on isuues including termination of contract on the basis of force majeur events including insecurity. In addition to complex issues on variation in DED and advanced work performed on the basis of such variation instruction by MPW, there is risk of non-perfromance by IVRCL due to the ongoing liquidation as going concern in India.
Works have remained inactive since the collapse of the formenr government on 14 August 2021. Data Source: Engineer's progress reports and audit reports submitted to ADB.

Increase in average journey speed on the project roads from 35 km/h to 50 km/h 2022. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The outcome will be assessed upon completion of the road construction. The work suspension and subsequent termination of the previous contractor hindered the timely achievement of the project outcome. However, the civil work contracts for section 1 and 2 were signed on 16 September 2017 and Notice to Proceed (NTP) were issued on 22 Jan 2018. The actual progress at Section 1 with a total length of 34km is at 72.66%. The actual progress at Section 2 with a total length of 48 km is 44.87%. The slow progress in both sections is due to unstable security situation in the area, restricted access to certain section of the road and LARP implementation.
Due to the suspension of AFG operations since the fall of the former government on 14 August 2021, the Works and EA's compliance with reporting requirements remain subject to resumption of ADB operations on Afghanistan. Data Source: Post-implementation surveys by MPW and supervision consultants.
